name: qa-test-reporting
description: Test reporting + coverage analytics: 15 skills covering JUnit XML / LCOV / Cobertura parsers, Allure / ExtentReports, build-an-X reporters (coverage-diff, test-run-summary-author), commercial integrations (Currents / TestRail / Xray / Zephyr), per-language coverage analyzers (Jest, JaCoCo, coverage.py), a risk-weighted unit-test coverage targeter, and 2 agents (daily-test-suite-aggregator, release-quality-report-agent) for cross-suite roll-ups and release-quality reporting.
